Section	Instruction	Task I	Task II	Task III	Task IV	Task V	Task VI
Task name	Enter the task name	-	-	-	-	-	-
Optimistic time (O)	The minimum time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceeds faster than normal	-	-	-	-	-	-
Most likely time (M)	The most likely time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceeds as normal	-	-	-	-	-	-
Pessimistic time (P)	The maximum time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceed slower than normal	-	-	-	-	-	-
Duration	The formula for calculating the mean or expected time is: Duration - (O+4M+P)/6	-	-	-	-	-	-
Early start time (ES)	The ES is the maximum EF of all predecessors, except for the first task where the ES=0	-	-	-	-	-	-
Early finish time (EF)	The formula for calculating the Early finish time is: (EF=ES+Duration)	-	-	-	-	-	-
Late finish time  (LF)	The LF time ts the minimum LS of all the successors, except for the last task where LF equals EF	-	-	-	-	-	-
Late start time (LS)	The formula for calculating the Late start time is: (LS=LF-Duration)	-	-	-	-	-	-
Slack time	The Slack time is calculated as LF minus EF. It can also be calculated as LS-ES. If the slack is “0”, then the task is on the critical path.	-	-	-	-	-	-
